svg.title: SnackSense · Winner, Hack SRM 6.0
svg.desc: SnackSense, winner of Hack SRM 6.0 with a prize of INR 60,000. Scan a snack's barcode and an LLM breaks down its ingredients, nutrition and health score, tailored to your diet. React, Node, Express, MongoDB, OpenAI.
